test_intent.expected_signal: Malformed entries are excluded individually and valid content has a stable digest.

test_intent.behavior: Fail closed before ranking and preserve deterministic bounded shortlist semantics.
test_intent.expected_signal: Unknown compatibility, pricing, policy, or usage metadata never reaches the shortlist.

test_intent.behavior: Replay stored snapshots independently of later live catalog changes.

The exact candidate passed all contract, adversarial, and fixture-isolation tests.
The exact candidate passed all offline catalog scenarios.

independent_validation.notes: The single-maintainer policy permits role-separated local validation and structured security review; remote CI and latest-head review remain independent shipping gates.
